sio2_melting_3.name: Melting of SiO2 - Level 3
sio2_melting_3.description: Simulate the melting of alpha quartz SiO2 by heating under NPT conditions using the Tersoff potential and the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the system by 3 times in each direction. Compute the diffusion constant (self-diffusivity) in the molten state and report the average value in m²/s.
